description: Kommunale Gebietsgliederung Leipzig: Straßenabschnitte is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by leipzig.de. Alphanumeric list of all road sections of the city of Leipzig. It includes the official street key, the official street name, the house number range, the statistical district and the postal code for each section of the road. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal districts of Leipzig: Road sections" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Statistische Einheiten, Leipzig, inspirerelevant. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The portal listing links a licence document on an intranet address that needs an access token; no licence statement could be read, so the licence is recorded as not stated. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
